summary: Verified new founder-task-type feature. Backend 29/29 pytest pass (added 5 new tests: founder creates Founder/Designer Task; founder switches task_type and assigned_to flips; designer PUT task_type/assigned_to is ignored; founder->designer sync - edits by founder are visible to designer). Replaced obsolete test_founder_create_task_auto_assigned (previous iteration asserted server overrode founder's task_type - no longer valid under new spec). Frontend Playwright E2E: FOUNDER new/edit dialog shows data-testid='task-task_type-select'; selecting 'Designer Task' updates dialog header to 'Designer Task · assigned to Designer' and persists; row shows 'Designer · Designer'. DESIGNER login sees founder-created Designer task AND the one that founder reassigned via type switch (shared DB sync verified); DESIGNER New Task dialog has NO task-task_type-select and header is 'Designer Task · assigned to Designer'; DESIGNER EDIT also has no task-task_type-select, task_name/category/brief/priority are disabled, but status/committed/delay/output remain editable. committed_time input type='number' (hours). Cleanup done.

issues: Pre-existing manual tasks created in prior iterations where committed_time was a datetime string (e.g. '2026-10-02T17:57') now render as '2026-10-02T17:57 hrs' because column was changed to numeric hours. Impacts only legacy rows; new entries are numeric. Consider a one-shot migration or allow backend to blank non-numeric committed_time.

action_items: (Optional) Data cleanup/migration for legacy tasks whose committed_time/manager_deadline were stored as datetime strings before the numeric-hours change; frontend now appends ' hrs' which looks odd for those legacy rows.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py create_task: founder role honors body task_type (Founder/Designer) with fallback to 'Founder Task'; defense-in-depth for designer forces 'Designer Task' - correct.
server.py update_task: when founder changes task_type, assigned_to is kept consistent server-side; designer PUT is whitelisted to {status, committed_time, delay_reason, output_link} - verified.
Tasks.js fieldList: founder includes 'task_type' and uses TASK_TYPES; designer fieldList omits it and makeEmpty() defaults based on role - matches spec.
manager_deadline / committed_time are numeric hour inputs; compute_delayed uses task.date for overdue - correct.

Minor: TaskIn/TaskUpdate still type manager_deadline/committed_time as Optional[str] despite being hours; could be float/Optional[float] for stronger validation (currently accepts anything, including legacy datetime strings).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on founder task-type selector + sync + designer restrictions
